name: Abyssal Cow
source:
"Changed by [spoiler]the Abyss[/spoiler] and armed with a strange backpack, this cow girl is a dangerous monster." - In-game description

The Abyssal Cow is the first type of [spoiler]demon[/spoiler] encountered in the dungeon, their appearances altered by high concentrations of magic and [spoiler]the Abyss[/spoiler]. They are laid-back and rude, with one calling [url=/c48304/]Yomi[/url]'s party "losers" before their fight. Despite this, the Abyssal Cow captured by the player will readily join the party out of boredom and wanting to be on the winning side.

In order to proceed to [spoiler]the Abyssal Gateways[/spoiler], the player must capture three Abyssal Cows and milk them. The milk then needs to be given to [spoiler]Anubis[/spoiler], who will inform Yomi's party on how to [spoiler]advance to the lower floors[/spoiler].

Floor(s): 20-23, 25
